main.description: Search saves by dominant color. Matches images whose palette contains a color perceptually close to the query color, ranked by closeness and pixel coverage. Requires authentication and an active supporter subscription.

color.description: Query color as hex RGB, e.g. #e63946.

library.description: If true, search only the viewer's own saves instead of the whole network.

collections.description: AT-URIs of collections to narrow the search to. Implies library scope.

errors.name: SupporterRequired
errors.description: The viewer must have an active supporter subscription to search by color.
